description: This file defines abstract and concrete grain classes with custom placement strategies, used in Orleans testing scenarios.

classes.name: CustomPlacementBaseGrain
classes.description: An abstract base class for custom placement grains, providing runtime instance identification.

classes.name: CustomPlacement_FixedSiloGrain
classes.description: A grain class with a fixed silo placement strategy for testing purposes.

classes.name: CustomPlacement_ExcludeOneGrain
classes.description: A grain class configured to exclude one silo in placement strategy.

classes.name: CustomPlacement_RequestContextBased
classes.description: A grain class that uses request context for placement strategy.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime identity of the current grain instance.
